{{nihongo|'''Murohime Shrine'''|室比賣神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Awa Province (Tokushima)]].

{{wikidata link|Q106852500|ja|室比賣神社|grok=none|check_date=2026-06-03}}

It is also written as '''Murohime Jinja'''.

=== History ===
It was enshrined at {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Okayama Castle}} in the medieval period. On maps and shrine plaques it is written as '''Murohime Jinja''', but the Tokushima Prefecture Shrine Office lists it as Murohime Shrine.

The enshrined deity is "Murohi," the consort of {{ill|Emperor Junnin|ar|الإمبراطور جونين|azb|جوننین (ایمپیراتور)|cs|Džunnin|de|Junnin|es|Junnin Tennō|eu|Junnin enperadorea|fa|امپراتور جوننین|fr|Junnin|hu|Dzsunnin japán császár|id|Kaisar Junnin|it|Junnin|ja|淳仁天皇|ko|준닌 천황|nl|Junnin|pl|Junnin|pt|Junnin|ru|Император Дзюннин|sh|Car Junnin|simple|Emperor Junnin|sl|Cesar Džunnin|sv|Junnin|th|จักรพรรดิจุนนิง|tl|Emperador Junnin|tr|Junnin|uk|Імператор Дзюннін|vi|Thiên hoàng Junnin|yo|Emperor Junnin|zh|淳仁天皇|zh_min_nan|Zyunnin Thian-hông|qid=Q329713}}. At the end of the {{ill|Nara period|af|Nara-tydperk|ar|فترة نارا|bcl|Panahon nin Nara|bg|Нара (период)|bn|নারা যুগ|ca|Període Nara|ckb|سەردەمی نارا|cs|Období Nara|de|Nara-Zeit|el|Περίοδος Νάρα|eo|Epoko de Nara|es|Período Nara|eu|Nara aroa|fa|دوره نارا|fi|Nara-kausi|fr|Époque de Nara|gl|Período Nara|he|תקופת נארה|hr|Nara (razdoblje)|hu|Nara-kor|id|Zaman Nara|it|Periodo Nara|ja|奈良時代|jv|Periodhe Nara|ko|나라 시대|lt|Nara laikotarpis|ml|നാറ കാലഘട്ടം|ms|Zaman Nara|nl|Naraperiode|nn|Naratida|no|Nara-perioden|oc|Periòde de Nara|pl|Nara (okres)|ps|نارا|pt|Período Nara|ro|Perioada Nara|ru|Период Нара|sh|Nara period|simple|Nara period|sk|Obdobie Nara|sl|Obdobje Nara|sr|Нара период|sv|Naraperioden|th|ยุคนาระ|tl|Panahong Nara|tok|tenpo pi kulupu lawa Nala|tr|Nara Dönemi|uk|Період Нара|ur|نارا دور|vi|Thời kỳ Nara|war|Panahon Nara|wuu|奈良时代|zh|奈良時代|zh_min_nan|Nara sî-tāi|zh_yue|奈良時代|qid=Q189178}}, she is said to have longed for the emperor and set out for {{ill|Awaji Island|ar|أواجي (جزيرة)|az|Avaci adası|bcl|Isla nin Awaji|be|Авадзі (востраў)|bg|Аваджи (остров)|bn|আয়াজি দ্বীপ|ca|Illa d'Awaji|ceb|Awaji Shima|cs|Awadži|da|Avaji|de|Awaji-shima|el|Αβάτζι|eo|Aŭaĝi|es|Isla Awaji|et|Awaji saar|eu|Awaji uhartea|fa|جزیره آواجی|fi|Awaji|fr|Awaji-shima|gl|Illa de Awaji|he|אוואג'י (אי)|hi|अवाजी द्वीप|hy|Ավաձի (կղզի)|id|Pulau Awaji|it|Isola Awaji|ja|淡路島|ko|아와지섬|la|Insula Awaji|lb|Awaji-shima|lt|Avadžis|nl|Awaji (eiland)|pl|Awaji (wyspa)|pt|Ilha Awaji|ro|Insula Awaji|ru|Авадзи (остров)|sl|Avadži (otok)|sv|Awaji|tg|Ҷазираи Авадзӣ|th|เกาะอาวาจิ|tr|Awaji Adası|uk|Авадзі|vi|Awaji (đảo)|wuu|淡路岛|zh|淡路島|qid=Q504373|lt=Awaji}} in a small boat, drifted ashore at this location, and was later enshrined here.

After being enshrined as Murohime Shrine, it was renamed Murohime Jinja in {{ill|1874|ab|1874|af|1874|als|1874|am|1874 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|1874|ar|1874|ary|1874|arz|1874|ast|1874|avk|1874|az|1874|azb|۱۸۷۴ (میلادی)|ba|1874 йыл|ban|1874|bar|1874|bat_smg|1874|bcl|1874|be|1874|be_x_old|1874|bg|1874|bn|১৮৭৪|bpy|মারি ১৮৭৪|br|1874|bs|1874.|ca|1874|cdo|1874 nièng|ce|1874 шо|ceb|1874|ckb|١٨٧٤|crh|1874|cs|1874|csb|1874|cv|1874|cy|1874|da|1874|de|1874|diq|1874|el|1874|eml|1874|eo|1874|es|1874|et|1874|eu|1874|fa|۱۸۷۴|fi|1874|fiu_vro|1874|fo|1874|fr|1874|frp|1874|frr|1874|fur|1874|fy|1874|ga|1874|gan|1874年|gcr|1874|gd|1874|gl|1874|gn|1874|gv|1874|hak|1874-ngièn|he|1874|hi|१८७४|hif|1874|hr|1874.|hsb|1874|ht|1874 (almanak gregoryen)|hu|1874|hy|1874|hyw|1874 թուական|ia|1874|id|1874|ilo|1874|io|1874|is|1874|it|1874|ja|1874年|jv|1874|ka|1874|kaa|1874|kk|1874 жыл|kn|೧೮೭೪|ko|1874년|krc|1874 джыл|ksh|Joohr 1874|ku|1874|kv|1874-ӧд во|la|1874|lb|1874|lez|1874 йис|li|1874|lij|1874|lmo|1874|lt|1874 m.|lv|1874. gads|mai|१८७४|map_bms|1874|mdf|1874|mg|1874|mhr|1874|mi|1874|min|1874|mk|1874|mr|इ.स. १८७४|mrj|1874 и|ms|1874|my|၁၈၇၄|myv|1874 ие|mzn|۱۸۷۴|nah|1874|nap|1874|nds|1874|nds_nl|1874|new|ई सं १८७४|nl|1874|nn|1874|no|1874|nrm|1874|nso|1874|oc|1874|olo|1874|or|୧୮୭୪|os|1874-æм аз|pa|1874|pl|1874|pms|1874|pnb|1874|pt|1874|qu|1874|ro|1874|ru|1874 год|rue|1874|sa|१८७४|sah|1874|scn|1874|sd|1874ع|se|1874|sh|1874.|shn|1874|simple|1874|sk|1874|sl|1874|smn|1874|sq|1874|sr|1874|stq|1874|su|1874|sv|1874|sw|1874|szl|1874|ta|1874|tay|kawas na 1874|te|1874|tet|1874|tg|Соли 1874|th|พ.ศ. 2417|tk|1874|tl|1874|tly|1874|tr|1874|tt|1874 ел|udm|1874 ар|uk|1874|ur|1874ء|uz|1874|vec|1874|vi|1874|vls|1874|vo|1874|wa|1874|war|1874|wuu|1874年|xmf|1874|yi|1874|za|1874 nienz|zea|1874|zh|1874年|zh_classical|一八七四年|zh_min_nan|1874 nî|zh_yue|1874年|qid=Q7761}} (Meiji 7).
